CLAIM OFFER [...] D.C. United look to rebound from a 4-1 loss Saturday at Orlando City. Tai Baribo scored his 16th goal, but the Lions overwhelmed D.C. United with their attacking style.

D.C. will get a similar challenge against Cincinnati on Wednesday and Saturday. It will welcome back standout defender Lucas Bartlett, whose absence because of a red-card suspension was apparent against Orlando. [...] Amplifying the frustration of both teams has been their inability to emerge from the pack. D.C. United have just two wins in their last 12 matches, going 2-5-5 over that span. Meanwhile, FC Cincinnati have won just one of their last nine, going 1-5-3.

"We're just not good enough to get results," Cincinnati coach Pat Noonan said. "We just have to keep pushing and not feel sorry for ourselves and see if we can turn our fortunes around."
